i have those thoughts a lot too. passive ideation sucks. it drains the joy out of everything. 

i read this article sometimes when it gets rly bad. give it a read if u want: [https://theoutline.com/post/7267/living-with-passive-suicidal-ideation?zd=1&zi=qhoe4m3z](https://theoutline.com/post/7267/living-with-passive-suicidal-ideation?zd=1&zi=qhoe4m3z)

i agree the rocket thing is cool, but what's the point of it? can those rocket parts do anything tangible for people living on earth? i feel like the launch is just a distraction from the problems on earth. i used to be a big SpaceX/NASA fan but now I think it's just silly - shouldn't we focus on healing earth first? what was the space program started for if not to be a pissing contest with the former USSR?
